run_majority_voting_on_trajectories: run majority voting on CWM-RL trajectory files to select the most frequent patch per instance
run_flaky_test_detection: run the majority voting script to detect and report flaky tests with mixed pass outcomes
run_subsampling_trajectories: run majority voting with a max samples limit to subsample trajectories per instance
run_save_selected_patches: run majority voting and save selected patches and best trajectories to JSONL files
review_Args_dataclass: review the Args dataclass that defines CLI parameters for trajectory glob pattern, save paths, and max samples
